runtime.description: The Castle fields a disciplined human army built around archers, griffins, knights, clerics, and angels. Castle heroes use Elite Strategem spell toggles to control neutral enemy deployment while supporting morale, cavalry charges, and late-game resurrection.

allowedDebt: Castle is promoted as a Human-donor Core scaffold with exact HotA/ToA stat targets and honest static-trace debt. Unit import rows, bundles, static portraits, preview manifests, lab sidecars, hero portraits, faction art, city billboard art, and dwelling billboard frames exist in the source plugin; release hardening still needs town layers/build-tree icons, UI exposure, and mechanics validation.

Castle uses skill_faction_homm3_castle for Elite Strategem by design. Basic grants Spread Out, Advanced adds Compress, and Expert adds Ambush as Castle-owned spellbook toggles backed by Homm3CastleEliteStrategemRuntime; level-1 Spread Out, level-2 Compress, level-3 Ambush, tactics legality, active indicator, spell icons, and subskill icons were user-accepted as complete on June 21.
Castle shares Human donors with Tower, Fortress, and vanilla Human. Donor reverse lookup must remain context-required.
